rule: Every public base table is either scoped (has shelter_id, so 0392/0396's restrictive policies filter it) or recorded here as deliberately unscoped, with a reason in checkable terms. scripts/check-tenancy-shared-tables.mjs fails on a table with no column and no record, and on a record for a table that now has the column or no longer exists. Item #tnc10; docs/decisions/2026-11-17-tenancy-unscoped-tables.md.

tables.shelters: The tenant table itself; its row is the shelter.
tables.scheduled_writer_runs: Installation monitoring, platform: the last outcome of each Worker-side scheduled job (0408). Says whether a job ran, owns no shelter data.
tables.permission_activities: Card catalogue: code-defined, identical for every shelter.
tables.card_features: Card catalogue: code-defined, identical for every shelter.
tables.card_grants: Card catalogue: what each card requires, identical for every shelter. Holds NO assignments (card, activity, level only); a shelter's role-to-card assignments are role_cards, which carries shelter_id. Decided in Part 10 (docs/decisions/2026-11-17-per-shelter-roles.md).
tables.card_includes: Card catalogue: cards a card brings with it, identical for every shelter. Holds no assignments. Decided in Part 10 (docs/decisions/2026-11-17-per-shelter-roles.md).
tables.features: Card catalogue: code-defined, identical for every shelter.
tables.translatable_fields: Schema metadata: which columns are translatable.
tables.translatable_labels: Schema metadata: which labels are translatable.
tables.product_admins: Platform: the product administrators (0411), logins that run the /platform console. Belongs to the installation, not to any shelter; asked only through is_product_admin().
tables.product_admin_lookups: Platform: audit of which email a product administrator checked (0422). Names no shelter; asked only by the product-admin functions.
tables.product_admin_login_grants: Platform: audit of first-login permits a product administrator gave (0425). It records for_shelter as a target, so it is not a shelter-scoped row; asked only by the product-admin functions.
